name: manual_0bf7ef
claim: When modelling a protocol rule, re-read which request's field each check compares (permit request ack versus finalization request ack); a mis-assigned field makes the healthy case refuse and the whole model misleading.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: first simulation refused the healthy flow because rule 3 was fed the finalization request's ack instead of the permit's.
